text:
liam: Heads-up - intake flood seen during the new calibrate+quant prebench. Workers OOMing and a bunch of 5xx from bench-prober.

sara: saw traces. root cause looks like parallel full-length replays for each model variant. we should avoid spinning up N full replays at once.

zoe: are the full replays necessary for initial validation? could we do lightweight signature checks first (shape, tokenizer mapping, param count), then run a sampled replay?

liam: exactly my thought. propose two-phase intake: (1) fast compatibility probe (stateless checks + tiny microbench across short seq lens), (2) staggered full prebench with adaptive concurrency per cluster util.

ben: tradeoffs: faster probes reduce false negatives but might miss perf regressions that only appear at long seq lengths. need a rule to escalate to full prebench if any microbench shows >x deviation.

zoe: Suggest thresholds: if microbench p95 latency deviates >20% from expected baseline or token-accuracy drops >1% (for eval sets) => schedule full prebench. also mark model with metadata `intake.verified=minimal` until full prebench passes.

sara: For compatibility checks: add a canonical tokenizer fingerprint and a param-hash. If tokenizer differs, fail hard unless owner approves. Param-hash mismatch should trigger a compatibility shim attempt (auto patch if mapping found).

ingest-bot: ingest-bot: created intake ticket #INT-4821 for model foo-2026-04-10, status=FAST_PROBE_RUNNING

liam: Operationally we need backpressure at the intake gateway: sampler should look at `prebench.queue_depth` and `cluster.util` before dispatch. If queue_depth > threshold, convert incoming models to 'deferred' and put them in a priority queue.

ben: Also add a leaky-bucket on prebench submissions to avoid hot bursts. rate-limit per-namespace/team to prevent noisy tenants from affecting global throughput.

zoe: Interfaces needed: intake->bench API needs a `priority` and `probe_mode` field (values: fast, full, staged). bench should return `probe_report_id` and `estimated_cost_tokens`. intake will use that to decide staged rollouts.

liam: Good. For gating: implement soft-accept semantics: 
 - FAST_PASS => register but `release_state=staged` with max qps=1 for 1h
 - FAST_WARN => register with `release_state=staged` but require owner ack to increase qps
 - FAIL => reject intake and create escalation ticket

ben: We should also store raw telemetry for audits. Keep two retention tiers: short-term high-res (1w) for debugging, long-term downsampled (90d) for trend/regression detection.

sara: Will add dashboards: microbench vs baseline, probe failure reasons, intake queue heatmap, per-team prebench cost.

liam: I'll prototype the two-phase intake state machine and the deferred queue. Assigning to me and ben for proto. Zoe please prototype the probe signature schema. Sara on dashboards. ingest-bot: please attach INT-4821 to the proto epic.

ingest-bot: ingest-bot: INT-4821 attached to EPIC-ONBOARD-2026-2

ben: timeline? can we have an experiment in staging next Wed?

liam: aiming for staging experiment Wed. follow-up sync Tue to walk the state transitions.
